caption:
You just watched a balloon for 20 seconds. 🎈

No product. No offer. Just curiosity. And you didn't scroll.

That's the whole game online:
→ Hook in the first second
→ Hold attention with tension
→ Then show the brand when they're already watching

Now imagine that was your business on their feed.
